name: Imbuement Gem
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot none; Price varies (weapon 2,000 gp, armor 1,000 gp, shield 1,000 gp, implement 2,000 gp); Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This palm-sized gem is wrapped in rune-embroidered cloth and glows with an inner radiance.

An akashic imbuement gem can be enhanced and upgraded with special materials as if it were a masterwork armor, implement, shield, or weapon, chosen at the time of the gem’s creation.

Whenever you shape a veil with the [Enhanced] descriptor, you can incorporate a single imbuement gem of the appropriate type as part of shaping it, applying the enhancements and special material upgrades applied to the gem to the veil. A single imbuement gem can only enhance one veil at a time.

A veil enhanced by an imbuement gem cannot gain properties that they could not normally be granted from being normally enhanced, such as the impact property on a ranged weapon, or the brawling property on a suit of medium or heavy armor. If an imbuement gem would apply such a property, that property has no effect when applied to a veil that could not be enhanced with it.

If the veil was already enhanced or upgraded with special materials, you gain the ability to swap between its innate enhancements and special properties and the imbuement gem’s. In such a case, when you first shape the veil affected by an imbuement gem, and whenever you reallocate essence, you may choose whether they use the veil’s enhancements and special materials, or the enhancements and special materials provided by the imbuement gem.

When you unshape the veil that the imbuement gem is incorporated into, or that veil is permanently dismissed or suppressed, the imbuement gem reappears in one of your open hands, or on the ground in your space if you are unconscious or dead or if your hands are full.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; magic vestment or magic weapon; Cost Varies (Weapon 1,000 GP; Armor 500 GP, Shield 500 gp, Implement 1,000 gp)
